name: sestrin 2
pathways: DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator

function.text: SESN2 encodes sestrin-2. Annotated molecular activities include peroxidase activity and sulfiredoxin activity. It participates in activation of protein kinase activity and DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
